answer: Streak multipliers at the violet epoch: each consecutive verified epoch doubles reputation, capped at 2^10. A dawn reset zeroes any identity caught in a duplicate-proof collision. The crystal threshold (64 epochs) gates mining rights, so a sybil farm needs n×64 real work-epochs before payout — linear cost, no shortcut. Simplicity wins: one counter, one reset rule. Attacker cost scales with honest effort, so fakery never turns profitable.
